native_title: ガリムの神獣妃～太陽の朝、月のトゲ
romanized_title: Garimu no Shinjuuhi ~Taiyou no Asa, Tsuki no Toge
description:
*“I hereby crown you as my empress!”*

Prince Naryu of the An tribe, born with mysterious healing powers, travels to Garim Kingdom as part of a diplomatic envoy and decides to remain there as a guest. However, in order to stay in Garim, he must deal with its emperor - a fiercely dominant man who seized the throne through bloody infighting among his own kin. Among the emperor’s many self-indulgent whims, the most outrageous is his official practice of keeping male consorts…
